title: KELLY SPRINGFIELD TIRE CO: TIRES:LINER (990 affected)
summary: AN IMPRESSION AT THE LEFT EDGE OF THE SERIAL IDENTIFICATION NUMBER, CAUSED BY A BENT SERIAL IDENTIFICATION TIN, HAS DAMAGED THE TIRES.

title: Ford Motor Company: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:ANTI-SKID SYSTEM (212 affected)
summary: ANTI-LOCK BRAKE SYSTEM CONTROLLERS DESIGNED FOR REAR WHEEL DRIVE CARS MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED ON THESE FRONT WHEEL DRIVE CARS..

title: PACCAR Incorporated: SUSPENSION:I-BEAM:SOLID:FRONT U-BOLT:SPRING TO I-B (330 affected)
summary: A DEFECT IN THE THREADS OF A U-BOLT MAY CAUSE IMPROPER LOADING, LONGITUDINAL CRACKING IN THE THREADS OF THE U-BOLT, AND PREMATURE FRONT STEER AXLE SPRING FAILURE.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: POWER TRAIN:AXLE ASSEMBLY (152,000 affected)
summary: THE DIFFERENTIAL OIL OF THE TRANSAXLE IS LOST OVER TIME DUE TO EVAPORATION. LOW OIL LEVELS CAUSE PREMATURE BEARING AND GEAR WEAR AND EVENTUAL FAILURE OF THE DIFFERENTIAL.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:POWER ASSIST:BOOSTER (7,000 affected)
summary: THE BLADES IN THE BRAKE VACUUM BOOSTER PUMP CAN WEAR PREMATURELY, CAUSING REDUCED BRAKE ASSIST PRESSURE WHEN THE BRAKE PEDAL IS APPLIED.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: EMERGENCY PARKING BRAKE:MECHANICAL:LINKAGES AND CA (54 affected)
summary: THE METAL SHEATHING OF THE PARKING BRAKE CABLE CAN SEPARATE ALLOWING THE INNER LOAD BEARING CABLE TO PULL THROUGH THE HOUSING, RELAXING CABLE TENSION AND RELEASING THE PARKING BRAKE.

title: General Motors, LLC: ENGINE COOLING SYSTEM:FAN (215,052 affected)
summary: THE ENGINE COOLING FAN BLADES BREAK AS A RESULT OF FATIGUE AND/OR VEHICLE INDUCED STRESS.

title: DORSEY CORPORATION: STRUCTURE:TAILGATE ASSEMBLY (60 affected)
summary: THE TOP HINGED REAR GATE (DOOR) HORIZONTAL STRUCTURAL MEMBER DEVELOPS FATIGUE CRACKS BECAUSE OF BENDING AT THE HINGES AND CENTER BRACE ATTACHMENT BRACKET.

title: General Motors, LLC: FUEL:FUEL LINES FITTINGS AND PUMP (1,771 affected)
summary: THE ENGINE MOUNTED FUEL FEED AND RETURN PIPES MAY FRACTURE DUE TO CONTACT WITH THE ENGINE FRAME DURING OPERATION.

title: ARVINMERITOR AUTOMOTIVE: BRAKES:AIR:CYLINDER WHEEL:CAM:ACTUATING (1,018 affected)
summary: THE BRAKE ASSEMBLIES DO NOT MEET THE BRAKE POWER AND BRAKE RECOVERY SECTIONS OF FMVSS 121 "AIR BRAKE SYSTEMS".

title: Motor Coach Industries, Inc: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC SYSTEM (8 affected)
summary: THE BRACKETS USED TO RESTRAIN THE "REFERENCE-ZERO" ARM OF THE DRIVE AXLE SLACK ADJUSTERS MAY FLEX EXCESSIVELY, AND PREVENT SELF ADJUSTMENT OF THE SLACK ADJUSTERS. THIS COULD DEGRADE BRAKE EFFICIENCY AS THE BRAKE SHOES WEAR.
